stations.title: Ines
stations.say: Can a rule be something we plug in?

stations.title: Price tag
stations.text: Any rule, plugged in, on any price.

captions: Theo's functions work. Now Ines plans a weekend sale and wants rules she can swap.
Each new rule means a new pricing function, copied from the last one.
You treat rules as values: write, pick, pass and call them, in four tasks.
Now Sunday's price comes from the weekend rule, plugged into one function.
Functions are values. The rules of the shop can change without new code.
